systems.name: 1.1 Fixed Camera System
systems.notes: Implement multi‑camera setup with trigger zones. Each room/angle has a predefined static camera position, FOV, and orientation. Smooth transitions when moving between cameras.
tasks: Define camera data per room (position, target, FOV)
Camera trigger volumes (boxes or distance checks)
Smooth interpolation between camera switches (lerp over 0.5s)
Letterbox or vignette effect during transition

systems.name: 1.2 Prerendered Background Pipeline
systems.notes: Render static background images from 3D scenes (pre‑baked offline) and load them as full‑screen canvases. Ensure 3D objects (player, items, enemies) depth‑sort correctly against the background.
tasks: Load background image per camera angle
Depth buffer from pre‑rendered depth map (if available)

systems.name: 1.3 3D Object Rendering
systems.notes: Software rasterizer draws player, enemies, and items on top of the prerendered background. Use depth testing or painter's algorithm for correct occlusion.
tasks: Integrate GLB model loading (via Three.js parsing)
Transform and project 3D models for each camera
Handle transparency and dithering for visual consistency

systems.name: 1.4 Input & Movement System
systems.notes: Tank controls (classic survival horror) with optional modern analog controls. Relative movement based on camera direction must feel natural regardless of camera angle.
tasks: Tank controls: up = forward relative to character
